metadata.title: Riemannian geodesic motions and null foliations
metadata.abstract: We study the non-collision problem: given a unit vector field $V$ on a complete Riemannian manifold $(M,g)$, under what conditions on $V$ are the maps $F_t(p)=\exp_p(tV(p))$ injective for all $t\in\mathbb{R}$? If such a vector field exists, we call it a geodesic motion on $M$. This occurs, for instance, when $V$ defines a geodesic foliation of $M$, in which case, the geodesic motion is called stationary. We show that geodesic motions on the Euclidean plane are necessarily stationary, that generic geodesic motions on round spheres are non-stationary, and that compact hyperbolic $3$-manifolds admit no geodesic motions. The non-collision problem has a Lorentzian interpretation: geodesic motions on $M$ correspond to one-dimensional null geodesic foliations of the spacetime $(M\times\mathbb{R},g-dt^2)$. In the second part of the paper, we focus on codimension-one lightlike geodesic foliations of anti-de Sitter space $\operatorname{AdS}^{1,n}$. We give a complete characterization of such foliations by means of causal curves in the Einstein universe and prove rigidity in the projective anti-de Sitter case. The last part of the paper is dedicated to the study of one-dimensional geodesic foliations of $\operatorname{AdS}^{1,2}$. We give a complete characterization when the foliation contains at least one timelike leaf.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 测地运动的不碰撞条件与 Lorentz 零叶状结构
analysis.workSummary: 对完备黎曼流形上的单位场，以 F_t(p)=exp_p(tV(p)) 对每个实 t 单射定义无碰撞，对应于 Lorentz 乘积的一维零测地叶状结构。定理1.3证明欧氏平面的连续场只有常值场可无碰撞。圆球定理4.1以 ∇V 在 V⊥ 上处处无实特征值判别，给 C¹ 开性及奇数维球上的非平稳例。定理5.1排除闭双曲三流形上的测地运动。
techniques: 常曲率 Jacobi 场与指数映射微分
闭双曲三流形的总体积和 Jacobi 行列式
沿特征线的曲率恒等式及最大值论证
负定二平面 Grassmannian 与双曲距离
analysis.breakthrough: 双曲三维路线用 t→±∞ 的体积控制得到横向特征值 ±1，再通过曲率恒等式推出 ∇_V V=0，最后应用既有测地叶状结构不存在定理。AdS 普遍覆盖的余维一零测地叶状结构对应 Einstein 宇宙普遍覆盖的不可延拓因果曲线，射影情形来自全零二维平面。三维 AdS 含时类叶时，时类区域的每个连通分支在适当交换两因子后用 H²→H² 的严格缩距图描述，统一 Lipschitz 常数小于 1 时得到全局时类叶状结构。
analysis.limitations: 球面与闭双曲部分的必要性证明直接使用 F_t 为微分同胚，而开头的无碰撞定义只要求单射并得同胚。由同胚到微分可逆的这一步有待核对。闭双曲结论限三维且调用既有不存在定理。AdS 普遍覆盖、双曲面模型和射影商的表述各有范围。所列章节用于核对陈述和论证路线，未独立验证整篇证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者在第5页明确声明研究阶段未用生成式 AI，全部数学论证和稿件由人完成。第1页命中为目录。其余正文及补检未见正向披露。

analysis.priorityReason: 从测地线不碰撞联系曲率、叶状结构与 Lorentz 几何。
